items.reason: Whole-set routing prints the set identifier, resolved Runtime path, and binding kind before execution renders the table.
Header printing is unconditional after successful routing, including inside the bound checkout.
The comparison uses resolved.ProjectPath normalized to the checkout root, losing the actual invocation directory and incorrectly omitting or naming the follow-up line.
BoundDefault triggers the binding-recorded announcement.
The former conditional bound-checkout message is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current-checkout path without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the HITL branch, which bypasses Drain header rendering.
Successful whole-set task execution prints one green done result line.
Commit SHA or verified no-op detail prints immediately beneath the done line.
The old Completed task line is removed, with success rendering centralized in printTaskDone.
Exhausted retries that fail the task produce one red failed result line.
Provider exhaustion that leaves the task open produces the distinct red out-of-agents result.
Quota recovery parking prints a yellow quota-paused line naming the verdict’s preset.
Interrupted agent execution prints the yellow interrupted result line.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reporting paths and add no Task result lines.
Attempt failure narration, timing breakdowns, and exhausted-walk narration are preserved.
Both new renderers use the existing output wrapper, preserving complete text without ANSI for redirected output.
Result styles use existing terminal color detection and NO_COLOR suppression.
Header and result rendering introduce no journal writes.

scores.rationale: Clear, focused rendering changes with useful regression coverage; invocation-directory handling is incorrect and its edge cases lack tests.
